description: SaunaLife GL4 Outdoor Garden Luxury-Series DIY Sauna Kit, 4 Persons - Thermo-Spruce Looking for a backyard sauna that blends modern design with lasting performance? The SaunaLife Garden Luxury-Series Model GL4 is crafted to impress, featuring a sleek linear profile, elegant contrasting finishes, and an integrated porch with eaves for a refined architectural touch. Expansive full-height glass brings in natural light and outdoor views, creating a bright, spacious, and serene wellness retreat right in your garden. Engineered with premium thermally treated spruce, the GL4 offers superior durability, resisting moisture, decay, and fungi for years of reliable use. Inside, smooth, knot-free benches contour perfectly for comfort, while soft LED lighting—both inside and beneath the eaves—sets the perfect ambiance day or night. Complete with tempered glass, weather-resistant construction, and an intuitive DIY-friendly design, this sauna combines elegance, resilience, and functionality, giving you professional results in as little as two days.
